comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Memory of the Ancient City Memorial Album, this is created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Iron-plated Paneling
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 250

Ingredients:
Mysterious Damask Rose x1
Special Ship Paint x1
Ignis Solution x10
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not.
